children: Bahrain-founded fintech firm Tarabut has secured $50 million from investors, including Saudi banks and financial institutions.
The fresh capital will be used to expand in Saudi Arabia and enhance its offerings, such as helping lenders assess the creditworthiness of borrowers via live, real-time cash flows.

Investors who participated in the funding round include Riyad Bank, GIB Saudi Arabia, X-Tech Fund, an investment fund managed by Saudi Awwal Bank’s investment firm SAB Invest, Kanoo Ventures and Zamil Group.

Established in 2017, Tarabut operates a financial infrastructure and open banking platform that connects banks, distributors and consumers. It enables lenders to embed financial services directly into their workflows under their own brand.
With a presence in Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Bahrain, Tarabut has processed more than five billion API calls across the region.
(Writing by Cleofe Maceda; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Bahrain fintech Tarabut secures $50mln from Saudi banks, investors
